metadata.status_reason: The canonical DSpace community remains primary. When it is unreachable, a publisher-owned Moritz article archive and a bounded legacy OSTLJ Wayback PDF scope provide publication-specific fallbacks; a real PDF passed the activation smoke.

navigation.pagination: DSpace REST API: community -> 50 issue collections -> scoped objects
navigation.pdf_location: DSpace ORIGINAL bundle content endpoint; Moritz live article PDFs; exact Wayback replay for the bounded legacy /students/groups/is/files/ scope
navigation.notes: Volumes 1-15 were published as I/S: A Journal of Law and Policy for the Information Society. The legacy handle resolves to a community, so host-wide fallback discovery was unscoped and capped before reaching most OSTLJ objects. Live fallback: https://moritzlaw.osu.edu/student-life/law-journals/ohio-state-technology-law-journal/ostlj-articles. Legacy fallback: Wayback CDX scope moritzlaw.osu.edu/students/groups/is/files/* with exact replay.
